mapper.select: SELECT object_type AS objectType, object_id AS objectId, spec::text AS spec, revision, based_on_version AS basedOnVersion, update_at AS updateAt, update_by AS updateBy FROM cfg_draft WHERE object_type = #{objectType} AND object_id = #{objectId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cfg_draft(object_type, object_id, spec, revision, based_on_version, update_at, update_by) VALUES (#{objectType}, #{objectId}, #{spec}::jsonb, #{revision}, #{basedOnVersion}, #{updateAt}, #{updateBy})
